messages:
marc: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands about hiring/headcount. Recording + slides: https://redwood.internal/all-hands/1805550000 :spiral_calendar:
sophia: Short summary: we are reallocating hiring capacity toward Platform Reliability and Dedicated work to meet enterprise demand. This is a reallocation and a short operational pause for lower-priority reqs.
alexa: Immediate action: mark non-critical open reqs as `on-hold` while we run a 2-week review. Critical or inference-impact reqs can be petitioned to stay open.
devon: Can you share numbers we can plan against?
sophia: High level: ~150 people company-wide. Net hiring tightening ~7-8% for Q2 (roughly 8-12 reqs paused). About 5-8 roles are expected to be reallocated into Platform Reliability/Dedicated.
cheng: Layoffs? managers need to answer team questions.
sophia: No company-wide layoffs tied to this. Primary levers are hiring pauses and reallocation. Any other actions are handled via People Ops 1:1s.
paul: Recruiting process: all open reqs default to `on-hold`. Managers file an exception in #recruiting-approvals with impact metrics; we respond within 48-72 hours. Tag `critical-hire` or `inference-impact` as needed.
marc: Manager script to use in 1:1s: "Leadership is prioritizing enterprise reliability; some external hires are paused temporarily while we review. If your role is affected, we'll discuss options privately and try to minimize disruption."
cheng: Internal mobility? engineers want to switch to Platform Reliability.
paul: Internal transfers are encouraged and fast-tracked. Use the same req with `internal-fasttrack`; expect a ~1 week turnaround.
alexa: Contractors and renewals will be reviewed case-by-case; critical contracts can be extended with approval.
sophia: Research/ML hires that directly tie to inference performance (runtime, quantization, Dedicated integration) are eligible; exploratory hires deprioritized. Route those through recruiting-approvals and tag `inference-impact`.
hr-bot: Docs: https://redwood.internal/hr/headcount-q2 (petition form), https://redwood.internal/hr/severance-q2 (FAQ). People Ops available for private questions.
paul: I'll publish the paused-req list + owners in #all-hands-updates by EOD. Managers: prepare exception petitions now.
marc: Thanks everyone. We'll post the updated org sketch and paused list when available, and follow up with FAQs. Closing thread.
